nom: ANUA Invisible Glow Finish Sunscreen Stick

aspects.libelle: Convenient stick format for on-the-go reapplication
Leaves skin glowy without shimmer, doesn't disturb makeup
Compact travel-friendly size and good value
Allergic reaction with lip swelling and burning

extraits.texte: I've never had a reaction to sunscreen, but the first day I used this my lips swelled and were burning which is a common allergic reaction symptom for me. I used it for four days just to make sure jt was actually a reaction to this and not something else. It is a little oily feeling for my liking but not as oily as some sunscreens! Wish it would've worked for me bc its very convenient.

My preteen daugter loves it and is now excited to put on sunscreen. She has hated the multiple other sunscreens I have bought her. Its goes in so essily, she puts it on in the car on the way to school. No sunburns in sight

This is a great reliable product and super convenient for on the go! I took this product with me on my vacation and wore it daily on the beach and reapplied it as often as possible. After wearing it for a week I can say it did a great job protecting my skin. Another thing to note is it doent leave a white cast or your skin oily.
Looks so nice with and without makeup. Doesnt make my makeup slide around. Glowy without shimmer and doesnt feel like sunscreen normally does.
this sunscreen is perfect to keep in your purse and reapply throughout the day! it's compact and actually transparent. i will be repurchasing.

reserve: The reviews rarely state the reviewer's skin type or specific skin concerns, so segmentation by skin type and by concern could not be produced from this set.
